test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two arguments I and II. Read the statement and the arguments carefully and select the appropriate answer from the given options.

**Statement:**

Private schools have increased their fees by 20 per cent for this academic year citing rising costs.

**Arguments:**

I. The government has lowered the taxes levied on private schools by 8 percent this year.

II. The Teacher's Union is protesting against the decision of private schools to cut salaries by 15 percent.

options.text: Both arguments I and II strengthen the statement
Argument I weakens, while argument II strengthens the statement
Argument II weakens, while argument I strengthens the statement
Both arguments I and II weaken the statement

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both arguments I and II weaken the statement.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement mentions that private schools have **increased their fees by 20% **due to rising costs.
 
• Let's **evaluate** the given arguments in light of this statement.
 
• **Argument I:** The government has lowered the taxes levied on private schools by 8% this year.
 
 
• This argument** does not** directly relate to the statement.
 
• Even if the taxes have been lowered, it** does not** necessarily mean that private schools **cannot increase** their fees.
 
• Hence, argument I **weakens** the statement.
 
 
 
• **Argument II:** The Teacher's Union is protesting against the decision of private schools to cut salaries by 15%.
 
 
• This argument also **does not **directly relate to the statement.
 
• It talks about private schools cutting salaries, which is **not mentioned **in the statement.
 
• Hence, argument II weakens the statement.
 
 
 
• Therefore, both arguments I and II **weaken** the statement. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Private schools **are educational institutions that are not run by the government but are owned and managed by** private individuals or organizations**.
 
• Instead of depending on **taxes for public (government) funding,** private schools maintain the autonomy to choose their students and are entirely or partially supported by the** tuition fees** paid by their students.
 
• Certain religious denominations or faiths, such** Roman Catholicism,** different branches of **Protestantism, or Judaism, **are linked to certain** private schools.**
